hint_ladder.title: Convert 0.6% to decimal
hint_ladder.text: Percent means per hundred, so 0.6% = 0.6/100 = 0.006. Isipin mong 'bawas dalawa' – move decimal two left. Dali lang!

hint_ladder.title: Set up multiplication
hint_ladder.text: Multiply the decimal by the whole amount: 0.006 × P85,000. Parang 6/1000 × 85,000. Simple lang.

hint_ladder.title: Simplify the calculation
hint_ladder.text: Cancel zeros: 85,000 / 1000 = 85, then 85 × 6 = 510. So P510 ang sagot. Walang kahirap-hirap.

hint_ladder.title: Confirm the answer
hint_ladder.text: Less than 1% of P85,000 ay P850. Since 0.6% is mas maliit, P510 is correct. Perfecto ang labas!

A.text: Correct. 0.6% of P85,000 is P510, computed as 0.006 × 85,000 = 510.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you shifted the decimal one place instead of two, treating 0.6% as 0.6, leading to wrong multiplication.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you misinterpreted 0.6% as 6%, so you computed 0.06 × 85,000 = 5,100.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you misapplied both the decimal conversion and the base amount, getting 6,000.

next_time_rule: Mental Trick: Convert decimal percent by dividing by 100 (0.6% = 0.006). 'Bawas dalawa' – move decimal two left, then multiply.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo ikaw ang treasurer ng inyong barangay. May budget na P85,000 para sa livelihood program, at kailangan mong i-allocate ang 0.6% para sa training materials. Ganito ang tamang pag-compute.

Conversion: 0.6% means 0.6 per 100, or 0.6/100 = 0.006. Parang sinabi mong sa bawat piso, 0.006 ang para sa materials. Multiply: 0.006 × P85,000 = P510.

Kaya sa budget na P85,000, P510 lang ang mapupunta sa materials. Tama ang computation. Less than 1% of P85,000 is P850, so P510 talaga dahil 0.6% is smaller.

**Watch-Out Zone: unit_conversion_trap** Maling shift gives P600 or P5,100. Usog dalawa!
